We plan to offer a rich selection of furniture from the established China e-commerce market to Hong Kong consumers, with delivery and assembly handled by KSK and warehousing support from UWML.
We believe that leveraging existing e-commerce platforms will allow us to reduce customer acquisition costs while accessing Hong Kong’s projected 84% online shopper market (Statista, 2027 forecast).
However, we will retain the infrastructure and strategic planning completed to date, positioning ourselves to re-enter the market once conditions stabilize.
